definitions.resid_to_spline / resid_to_chord: mean over waypoints of the closest-point distance (full PCA-64 space) from each optimised waypoint to the polyline of the spline path / to the chord, divided by the mean natural twin change norm of plan entries at the same |shift| (Goodfire) or the carrier's own natural twin change (old test)
definitions.r2_spline / r2_chord: causalab intrinsic R^2: 1 - RSS/TSS of the optimised waypoints in the spline's 99%-variance SVD basis, RSS to the closest point on the spline (resp. chord) polyline
definitions.r2_chord_own_basis: same with the chord's own basis (1-d; near 1 for any path spanning the chord)
definitions.chord_baseline_*: Goodfire's linear baseline: the chord itself scored against the spline
definitions.summary_64d / summary_32d: optimised 32-d path padded with the training mean (0) to 64-d, as causalab pads dropped dims / everything truncated to the top-32 PCs
definitions.SE: over pairs (Goodfire) or over carriers, targets averaged within carrier (old test)
definitions.old_reverse_test: optimised per-carrier waypoint deltas t = 0.125..1 (session2_reverse_path.json); spline and chord are the gap-1 natural-norm paths (deltas from the carrier), spline densified to 41 points

data_separation.carriers: each pair's 16 carriers = every probe/test clip at the source value, filled to 16 with seeded knot clips: knot fill per pair [4, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 3, 5] (of 16); test clips per pair [5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5]. The knot clips are also in the PCA / ring fit set (full-clip and context-only).
data_separation.kappa: the von Mises readout concentration kappa was fitted by max likelihood on the TEST clips' unedited forecasts, and test clips are also carriers
data_separation.behaviour_centroids: the behaviour centroids b_v (and so the target spline) used ALL clips at each value (knot + probe + test, carriers included), unedited forecasts
data_separation.readout: the native direction probe (W, b) was fit on probe clips; probe clips are also carriers
data_separation.note: added 2026-09-28 after QA; no number in this file changed. The spline / chord references here are fitted on FULL-CLIP knot activations while the edit is on the carriers' context-only activations; see results/session2_pullback_goodfire_ctxring.json for the rescoring against the context-only ring
